define.name: GUARD_SIZE_DEFAULT
define.doc: The driver must not put any STREAM_LINK or STREAM_TERMINATE blocks in the final GUARD_SIZE bytes of the last valid page.

enum.name: BLOCK_TYPE
enum.doc: The CDM control stream block header type.

field.name: block_type
field.doc: Compute Kernel header.

field.name: indirect_present
field.doc: Indirect address present bit.

field.name: global_offsets_present
field.doc: Global Offsets present bit.

field.name: event_object_present
field.doc: Event Object present bit.

field.name: usc_common_size
field.doc: USC Common Store allocation size (64 byte chunks).

field.name: usc_unified_size
field.doc: USC Unified Store allocation size (16 byte chunks).

field.name: pds_temp_size
field.doc: Number of temporaries to allocate (16 byte chunks).

field.name: pds_data_size
field.doc: Number of constants to load (16 byte chunks).

field.name: usc_target
field.doc: Whether to run on any cluster or all clusters.

field.name: fence
field.doc: Wait for fence acknowledgement from USC.

field.name: data_addr
field.doc: PDS Data Address for the compute kernel.

field.name: sd_type
field.doc: The sequential dependency type to apply to this task.

field.name: usc_common_shared
field.doc: When set, the allocation size specified in USC_COMMON_SIZE is for Shared Registers, instead of Coefficients.

field.name: code_addr
field.doc: PDS Code Address for the compute kernel.

field.name: one_wg_per_task
field.doc: When set, CDM will clamp the number of workgroups per task sent to PDS to a value of 1.

field.name: workgroup_x
field.doc: The number of workgroups in the X dimension of the workspace.

field.name: workgroup_y
field.doc: The number of workgroups in the Y dimension of the workspace.

field.name: workgroup_z
field.doc: The number of workgroups in the Z dimension of the workspace.

field.name: indirect_addrmsb
field.doc: MSB of indirect work group size definitions.

field.name: indirect_addrlsb
field.doc: LSB of indirect work group size definitions.

field.name: max_instances
field.doc: The maximum number of work items to allow in a task (0=32, 1=1, ..).

field.name: workgroup_size_x
field.doc: The number of work items in the X dimension of the work group.

field.name: workgroup_size_y
field.doc: The number of work items in the Y dimension of the work group.

field.name: workgroup_size_z
field.doc: The number of work items in the Z dimension of the work group.

field.name: global_offset_x
field.doc: The offset to apply to the Global ID X dimension.

field.name: global_offset_y
field.doc: The offset to apply to the Global ID Y dimension.

field.name: global_offset_z
field.doc: The offset to apply to the Global ID Z dimension.

field.name: block_type
field.doc: Stream Link header.

field.name: link_addrmsb
field.doc: MSB of Stream link address.

field.name: link_addrlsb
field.doc: LSB of Stream link address.
